Submission Instructions

  1. Select your assigned manuscript shelfmark from the course inventory.
  2. Lookup and verify authority IDs in Trismegistos (TM), Pinakes, and Diktyon.
  3. Write a valid TEI XML snippet containing <teiHeader> with full <msIdentifier>, <msContents>, and <physDesc> (including support, foliation, layout, and scribal hands).
  4. Prompt an LLM (e.g. Claude or GPT-4) to extract the same metadata from a raw library catalogue entry, and identify at least two subtle hallucinations or schema violations.
  5. Submit your validated TEI snippet and a 300–500 word comparison detailing how structured schemas enforce scholarly rigor against probabilistic AI errors.
